{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The national security threat from climate change is real, urgent, and severe.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate change will lead to new conflicts over refugees and resources.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate change will lead to new suffering from drought and famine.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate change will lead to catastrophic natural disasters.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Climate change will lead to the degradation of vital ecosystems across the globe.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will undertake measures to enhance energy independence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will promote efficiency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will promote clean energy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will promote renewable sources of power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will seek to implement agreements and build on the progress made during climate talks in Copenhagen, Cancun, and Durban.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President and the Democratic Party will work to ensure a response to climate change policy that draws upon decisive action by all nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The goal is an effective, international effort in which all major economies commit to reduce their emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nations will meet their commitments in a transparent manner.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The necessary financing will be mobilized so that developing countries can mitigate the effects of climate change and invest in clean energy technologies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration has taken a leadership role in ongoing climate negotiations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration will work to ensure that other major economies like China and India commit to taking meaningful action.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Obama administration has worked regionally to build clean energy partnerships in Asia, the Americas, and Africa.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
